body.title: About your body

body.periodTrackDesc: Helps the AI adapt training load and recovery without medical claims.

disclaimer.title: Health disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Calisthenics Quest provides general fitness guidance and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult a doctor before starting a new exercise program, especially if you have injuries, heart conditions, or other health concerns. Stop immediately if you feel pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath.
disclaimer.accept: I understand this app is not medical advice and I train at my own risk.

period.title: About Period Tracking
period.summary: Tracks flow intensity and cycle days to guide non-medical training load pacing.
period.guidance: Higher-flow or cramp-heavy days may favor slightly reduced abdominal strain and gentler recovery mobility, while keeping your weekly plan safe.
period.disclaimer: For personal awareness and fitness pacing only — not medical or diagnostic advice.

pain.title: About Pain & Symptom Tags
pain.summary: Records soreness or symptom patterns across the month.
pain.guidance: Structural tags (lower back, leg, joint) also protect your Daily Check-in safety filter by avoiding contraindicated movements.

supplements.title: About Supplements
supplements.summary: Keep a consistent daily log alongside your workout habits.
supplements.guidance: You can add custom supplements and archive old items anytime without losing past calendar logs.

medications.title: About Medications
medications.summary: Notes active medication days alongside training readiness.
medications.guidance: When painkillers, antibiotics, or cold/flu medication are logged, the AI coach favors conservative workout intensity.

sleep.title: About Sleep & Recovery
sleep.summary: Overnight duration and subjective sleep quality anchor weekly readiness.
sleep.guidance: Short sleep nights (< 6 hours) trigger conservative volume cues in plan adaptation.

learnMore.disclaimer: For personal fitness awareness only — not medical advice.
